name: spotlight-card
title: Spotlight Card
description: Surface card illuminated by environmental ambient light that follows the cursor, revealing surface texture and subtle edge chamfering without decorative glow.

props.name: variant
props.description: Base elevation and surface depth tier

props.name: spotlightSize
props.description: Radius in pixels for the ambient radial falloff

props.name: ambientIntensity
props.description: Max opacity of the ambient radial light

examples.title: Ambient Illuminated Card
examples.description: Quiet surface card revealing edge chamfers as the pointer traverses.
examples.code:
<SpotlightCard variant="tactile">
  <SpotlightCardHeader>
    <SpotlightCardTitle>Environmental Sensor</SpotlightCardTitle>
    <SpotlightCardDescription>Thermal and airflow metrics</SpotlightCardDescription>
  </SpotlightCardHeader>
  <SpotlightCardContent>
    Ambient atmosphere is treated as a global condition.
  </SpotlightCardContent>
</SpotlightCard>
